Care that stays in

One clinician

You see the same person every week. No triage queue, no starting your history again for somebody new.

Room to be slow

How we work

Three ways in,
one way through

Taking new people
/ 01

Weekly one to one

A clinician trained in CBT, ACT or psychodynamic work, matched to what you are actually dealing with rather than to whoever happens to have a free hour.

/ 02

Groups and courses

Eight people, eight weeks, one room. Mindfulness, art therapy, and a sleep course that has a waiting list for a reason.

/ 03

The six days between

What you do in the week you are not here matters more than the hour you are. We send you something to work with, and none of it is homework.

The practice

Why people stay

22 Languages

Our clinicians work in twenty-two languages, and we won't put you in your second one.

14 Years

Fourteen years of practice sits behind every programme we put in front of you.

5 Rooms

Five rooms across three cities. All of them quiet, none of them beige.

10k People

Ten thousand people have sat in one of those rooms. Most stayed longer than they meant to.

Anna Predko

Anna came in for work stress and stayed for something older than that. Two years on she still books the same Tuesday hour, and now she can say what it is for.

Max Shushan

Maxim spent a decade managing anxiety by avoiding things. He is not cured of it. He has just stopped arranging his life around it.
